title: Mototolo operation transferred to RPM
description: Mototolo operations transferred to RPM as a wholly owned operation after acquisition of the remaining joint-venture interests.

title: Valterra Platinum demerger took effect
description: Demerger of Anglo American's controlling interest in Valterra Platinum took effect.

title: Anglo American exited its remaining Valterra stake
description: Anglo American completed sale of its remaining approximately 19.9% interest in Valterra.

title: Matla coal supply agreement took effect
description: New long-term Matla coal supply agreement took effect, with stated end date 30 November 2043.

title: The Constitution took effect
description: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996 came into operation. It provides the constitutional framework for institutions and the three spheres of government.

title: Census 2022 statistical release published
description: Statistics South Africa published the Census 2022 statistical release. The provincial 2011 and 2022 counts shown in this workspace come from Table 2.2.
